Garage door closes a few inches and then reverses?

Odds are it's not the motor. It's the safety sensors, those two small eyes a few inches off the floor on either side of the door. Humidity, sprinkler spray, spider webs and one bump can knock them out of line.

Try this: clear anything near them, wipe both lenses, and look for two steady lights. A damaged or corroded wire means it's time for a pro. Never bypass the sensors.

The full fix checklist is on the 305doors.com blog. Link in bio.
